# Event Series

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EventSeries>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A recurrence or schedule that issues a series of concrete [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) occurrences — a weekly standup, an annual conference. Distinct from any one occurrence; the recurrence rule is a projection concern (iCalendar RRULE), not a core property.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

Use [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the planned recurrence or schedule that ISSUES concrete event occurrences — a weekly standup, an annual conference — when the series-vs-occurrence distinction (planned vs actual) matters.

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing a single dated occurrence as an [`EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md) (each instance is a [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) linked by [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](../properties/gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md)), and avoid hand-authoring rich recurrence structure — the RRULE is a projection concern, not core clutter.

### How to use

- Type the schedule [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md), attach a [`gmeow:RecurrenceRule`](gmeow-RecurrenceRule.md) via [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](../properties/gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md), and link each concrete [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) it issues with [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](../properties/gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) (read back via [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](../properties/gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md)).

### Examples

- ex:standup a [`gmeow:EventSeries`](gmeow-EventSeries.md); [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](../properties/gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md) ex:weeklyMon; [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](../properties/gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) ex:standup20240603.
